# matterbridge_devices (Data Source)

The devices that the plugins registered in Matterbridge (the Matter devices that the controllers see).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "matterbridge_devices" "zigbee2mqtt" {
  plugin = "matterbridge-zigbee2mqtt"
}

output "unreachable_devices" {
  value = [for d in data.matterbridge_devices.zigbee2mqtt.devices : d.name if !d.reachable]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `plugin` (String) Only the devices of this plugin. If you do not set it, the devices of all plugins.

### Read-Only

- `devices` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--devices))

<a id="nestedatt--devices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `devices`

Read-Only:

- `config_url` (String) The configuration URL of the device.
- `endpoint` (Number) The endpoint number.
- `id` (String) The endpoint ID.
- `name` (String) The device name.
- `plugin` (String) The plugin.
- `power_source` (String) ac, dc, ok, warning, critical or "".
- `reachable` (Boolean) True if the device is reachable.
- `serial_number` (String) The serial number, for example the IEEE address for zigbee2mqtt.
- `type` (String) The Matter device type, for example DimmableLight (0x0101).
- `unique_id` (String) The unique ID in Matterbridge.
